Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber Spirit Gas Grill in 25 years. I love the improvement they made for this latest version, especially to the new flatter cooking grates.

Results.ReviewText: Looks great and does a nice job. It gets hot very quickly. I am a bit disappointed that the back panel on the LP version is so small. Why doesn’t it cover more of the back of the unit?

Results.ReviewText: Just love our Weber grill. The Spirit E-310 cooks everything evenly and perfectly. The grill is quite large. The grates are easy to clean. It’s simply an outstanding bbq. You can’t go wrong purchasing one of these.

Results.ReviewText: Solid construction. Heats quickly. Seals well. Very good heat distribution over entire grill. Design minimizes flare-ups. While you will pay a bit more, it is notably of better quality than the plethora of inexpensive brands. When unpacking the box, you will notice the heft and solid construction of the parts.

Results.ReviewText: Love it so far. Have cooked salmon filets and they turned out delicious. I even used the user manual to prepare and cook them. Fit and finish of the grill are outstanding. A very attractive grill, the cover fits it well. Just a heads up to protect the paint when installing the gas tank, lay a towel on the bottom front of the cabinet to slide the tank into place.
Results.Title: First use and there will many more!

Results.ReviewText: I am a senior woman and find it very easy to work. I enjoyed the food I prepared on it.

Results.ReviewText: The E-310 gas grill far exceeds my expectations. No matter what I’m cooking the results are amazing.

Results.ReviewText: Unfortunately I will never purchase another Weber. My first Weber lasted 15 plus years. This Weber lasted 5 before the base rusted and door rusted off. Contacted customer service and was told base is no long under warranty. Thanks for the disposable grill Weber.

Results.ReviewText: I never have given a review on any barbeques ive purchased in the past but that changed after this one. From the very clear and concise instructions that made this assembly enjoyable, to the cooking which was so much better than all the ones in the past, to the easy clean up after, if I could give this a 6 out of 5 I would. By far leaps and bounds ahead of the competition for the same price range. You definitely will not be disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-310 is my first gas grill. As a dedicated charcoal chef, I wish I had known how easy this grill would be to operate and how great the food would taste. I will never go back.

Results.ReviewText: Cooking grates are a little loose when cleaning them they move back and forth ,thats the only thing i can see that i dont like on this beautiful weber barbecue.  Easy to assemble easy to use.
Results.Title: One issue great bbq

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Sprit 310.  The first lasted 10 years with a fair amount of care and being stored in a garage each winter.  The electronic igniter rusted out after about 5 years but I was able to install a generic push button igniter that lasted another 5 years.  I've owned several, cheaper, brand-name grills that rarely lasted more than 3 years so the more expensive Weber is cost effective in the long run.  Weber will be my brand choice for as long as I purchase grills
Results.Title: A quality, long-lived product

Results.ReviewText: Cooks at a perfect temperature. Love our new Weber Spirit E310

I had a couple of webers before no complaints my last grill was a Weber gold genesis awesome grill ,

Results.ReviewText: At some point, a "Running Change" (their words) was made to manufacture the rear panel of the propane compartment to only half height of the original. This will allow critters to access the compartment and make themselves a nice home, likely causing damage and scaring the ever-loving fecal matter out of me and them at some point. The store ad photos, included instructions, and the store model all have the standard height panel. Called Weber who said they could "sell" me the taller panel for $70 plus shipping. Overall, I love the grill. Well made, and cooks great. Gave it one less star due to poor customer service. I'll deal with any animal problem if it arises.
Results.Title: Very nice grill, but.........

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with grill. Controls help ensure a good outcome. Only complaint- purchased a Weber cover for it- first time taking off- tear at corner of cover that wasn’t there when purchased. Had mild wind - for $90- should hold up better.

Results.ReviewText:
Have had my three burner Weber spirit for several years and use it regularly. While I was cleaning it I noticed the burner tube was worn out and called Webber customer service to buy the set.  The got some info from me and determined I was still under warranty and within minutes had my order set to ship free.  
Within a week or so my parts arrived and my Webber is working like new!
Webber customer service folks are great, they initiated the warranty check and hooked me up just like that.  Grill on!

Results.ReviewText:
The grill performs really well but be prepared that they rust really bad.  Unfortunately, Weber does not warranty their grills the same.  The II series models are covered by a 10 year all inclusive warranty where this series is only 2 years for this issue.  Why is the warranty less than other units?  Perhaps they know this unit won't last longer than that and will rust?  I contacted customer service and they will only discount the parts by 20% and with the parts being so expensive it's hardly worth fixings this rust bucket. 

It's disappointing as the grill performs really well and I like that parts are readily available.
Results.Title: Great grill if you like Rust

Results.ReviewText: I have owned three previous Weber Grills and bought this one on just on the merit of the brand name. In the end, was quite disappointed to say the least. While there were more than a few things that were subpar, the most annoying part is that the overall build seems a bit flimsy. More than that, it appears that they changed a part for the grill (a back panel) which was not reflected in the instructions. As such, it appeared that the wrong part was included and I stopped assembling it in case I needed to send the whole thing back. After three calls to customer service, I finally got someone who informed that the company changed the part and did mention that it was neither reflected in the instructions nor the legs into which it is inserted (which now has extra mystery holes that nothing goes into). While I am somewhat doubting this answer (as the flame mechanism is rather open to the weather, I had no choice but to use the part they sent. The grill works fine, it seems, but it is certainly my last Weber. There are too many good options out there to settle for this annoyance and lousy customer service/response time. Sorry guys.
Results.Title: Disappointing; not the Weber I used to know

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
